item.title: Srinagar:Unidentified Man critically injured in Road Accident
item.description: Srinagar,Feb 10: An unidentified man sustained critical injuries after being struck by a car in the Chanapora area of Srinagar, officials said. Officials said the accident involved a Swift Dzire vehicle bearing registration number JK01AU-0385. The vehicle was reportedly, driven by a man from Zewan, Srinagar. item.title: No role of cabinet in Vaishno Devi ropeway project: CM Omar Abdullah
item.description: Jammu, Feb 10: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Tuesday clarified in the Legislative Assembly that the Council of Ministers had no role in approving the ropeway project for the Shri Mata Vaishno Devi shrine. He said that after examining official records, it was found that neither the cabinet nor the Administrative Council had cleared the project. According to the Chief Minister, the approval was granted by the Lieutenant Governor in September 2024, prior to the formation of the elected government

item.title: Unemployment rate in J&K at 6.7%, higher than national average: Govt
item.description: WAJAHAT SHABIR SRINAGAR: At present J&K’s overall unemployment rate stands at 6.7%, significantly higher than the national average of 3.50%, the government of Jammu and Kashmir informed the assembly on Monday. As per the data tabled in assembly it was further informed that unemployment rate in Jammu and Kashmir will be 6.7% in 2019-20 as compared to national average of 4.8%.
